verdict.reasons: The skill omits everything the recordings show that is needed. All three runs follow the same 15-call path. 1 oak_log placed alone gives 4 oak_planks. 2 planks stacked vertically (col 0, rows 0-1) give 4 sticks. A second oak_log gives 4 more planks. The pickaxe needs 3 planks across row 0 and sticks at (1,1) and (2,1). The skill states none of this. It also claims inventory is checked at the end, which the recordings do not show; the runs never re-check inventory after crafting. Its procedure is generic and mostly restates the prompt.
